component.name: ffmixer
component.summary: TotalMix FX-style mixer for the RME Fireface 800

description.p: A mixer and settings app for RME Fireface interfaces on Linux, inspired by TotalMix FX. It controls the unit through FFADO.
Use at your own risk: ffmixer sends commands to real audio hardware, and a mistake or a bug could damage equipment or your hearing. Not affiliated with or endorsed by RME.
